name: Lau bo
summary: The 18 May 2020 city page names lẩu bò with bún chả cá, bún thịt nướng, nem lụi, bún mắm nêm, and bê thui as dishes for a longer stay. It does not describe the pot.
origin: Named on that Da Nang page. A broth was not printed.
howToEat: The page names the hotpot and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: No street on the 18 May 2020 page. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Lau bo — named for a longer Da Nang stay
seoDescription: The 18 May 2020 Da Nang page names lẩu bò for a longer stay and does not describe the pot or a street. Check on arrival.
